title: Rest isn't a reward (window seat, pause reel, Painted 2D)

captions.instagram:
You don't have to earn your rest. 📖☕

Rest isn't what's left over once everything is done.
It's a window seat, a warm cup and one more chapter.
The day can wait for ten minutes.

Send this to someone who needs a slow evening.

#rest #slowliving #selfcare #emotionalwellness #soundmind
